Official artifact ZIP bytes were downloaded and SHA256 matched GitHub API digest fields, then extracted member hashes were replayed. Artifact attestations were not independently verified.

Six default mirror receipts explicitly record uidProfileChecks for controlled composition, identity, session and CLI contracts, with nativeProfileQueryAttempted=false/accountUsed=false. This is not a live native Profile result.

SDK quality logs and native npm build artifacts are outside this twelve-main-archive audit; npm publication is not established.
No historical source was recompiled locally; workflow source receipts and GitHub metadata supply the source binding. No result from 7c8361c or any later local revision is included.
Download bytes count the twelve artifact ZIP response bodies only; metadata response sizes and TLS/HTTP overhead are not included. The redundant shared-main artifact was not downloaded.

laterLocalScopeExclusion: Later local changes, including signing-tool restoration and the prepare CLI command, are outside this exact-source CI evidence.
